description: Agent Agriculture Records: submit irrigation and water-use records with the schedule, allocation and crop plan they answer to: the moment the records are read at; the water allocation the operation’s record states with its reference, volume, unit and the moments its period starts and ends; each field the crop plan lists with its id, reference, name and practice (irrigated or dryland); each planting record with its id, reference, field and crop; each scheduled irrigation with its id, reference, field and the moment due; each irrigation log entry with its id, reference, the scheduled irrigation it completes, field, the moment irrigated, the volume used and its status (completed or incomplete). The signed report gives the irrigation log and the schedule, each scheduled irrigation due by the reading moment against a completed record, the water use the log records inside the allocation period against the allocation, each field in the irrigation log against a planting record behind it, and each irrigated field against the practice the plan lists for it, and counts them, and names divergent irrigation records: a scheduled irrigation with no completed record, water use recorded past the allocation the operation’s own record states, a field in the irrigation log with no planting record behind it, and irrigation recorded on a field the plan lists as dryland; then an irrigation entry naming a scheduled irrigation the schedule does not hold and an entry on a field the plan’s field list does not hold, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No irrigation entries, a schedule with no reading moment, an allocation with no volume, or irrigated fields with no planting records beside them leaves those points unverified. Fields, entries and schedule entries match by letters and digits, an entry with no status reads as completed, a scheduled irrigation due on or before the reading moment needs a completed entry naming it, and water use sums the volumes dated inside the allocation period in the unit the allocation states. This reads whether every scheduled irrigation ran, the water stayed inside the allocation, and every irrigated field was planted and planned as irrigated. Verdict agri_irrigation_divergent, agri_irrigation_partial, agri_irrigation_unverified or agri_irrigation_consistent. POST /api/agri-irrigation-check. Reads the farm production records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it visits no farm, takes no soil or tissue sample, contacts no regulator or certifier and issues no certification, which stay with the operation, its agronomists, its regulators and its certifiers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Agriculture Records reads a farm operation’s own production records: crop and production plan records, planting and seed records, pesticide and fertilizer application records, irrigation and water-use records, soil test and nutrient records, harvest and yield records, livestock records and field-to-lot traceability records, each against the planting, input application and harvest records, the plan’s fields, varieties and windows and the seed records, the applicator and license records and the pre-harvest intervals, the schedule, the water allocation and the fields the plan lists, the planting and application records, the birth, purchase, movement and treatment records and the herd count, the planting and harvest records and the shipments, or the testing schedule, the fertilizer applications and the nutrient recommendations on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the crop and the herd: what the plan calls for, what the field logs show, what was applied and when, and whether the harvest and the traceability hold up; the Agent Food Safety Records family reads a food business’s safety records downstream, after production, and the Agent Customs Records family reads the border filings for goods, while this family reads the farm’s own records upstream, in the field, and reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-agriculture-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-agriculture-records/.
